text: はっぱの　うらがわに　たまった　あさつゆ　だけを　のんで　くらす。

structure.jp: はっぱの　うらがわに　たまった
structure.en: that has collected on the undersides of leaves

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: はっぱの　うらがわに　たまった　あさつゆ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a thing describes that thing. はっぱの　うらがわに　たまった　あさつゆ = 'morning dew that has collected on the undersides of leaves'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here the first action is the way the second is done. のんで　くらす = 'lives by drinking'.
